summary: The resolver at packages/features/profile/lib/hideBranding.ts:35-45 encodes the rule (organizationHideBranding overrides entityHideBranding) and exposes it as getHideBranding (50-80), shouldHideBrandingForEvent (116-153), shouldHideBrandingForTeamEvent (158-164) and shouldHideBrandingForUserEvent (169-181). The booking-facing surfaces go through it: apps/web/lib/team/[slug]/[type]/getServerSideProps.tsx:199, apps/web/server/lib/[user]/[type]/getServerSideProps.ts:299, apps/web/lib/d/[link]/[slug]/getServerSideProps.tsx:61,103, apps/web/app/(booking-page-wrapper)/team/[slug]/[type]/pageWithCachedData.tsx:36, apps/web/modules/bookings/views/bookings-single-view.getServerSideProps.tsx:251-253 and packages/features/ee/payments/pages/payment.tsx:58. The automation path does not. Every workflow-scheduling call site computes the flag as the raw individual-owner column: packages/features/bookings/lib/service/RegularBookingService.ts:2618,2793,2808 (`!!eventType.owner?.hideBranding`), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleConfirmation.ts:459,472 (fed by selects at :311 and :361 that fetch only `owner.hideBranding`, typed at :245-247), packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:471, packages/features/handleMarkNoShow.ts:377, packages/features/bookings/lib/handleBookingRequested.ts:112 (type at :30-35 carries `owner.hideBranding` and only `team.parentId`), packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.ts:230, packages/features/ee/round-robin/roundRobinManualReassignment.ts:671, and packages/features/ee/managed-event-types/reassignment/services/ManagedEventManualReassignmentService.ts:188. For a team or organization event `eventType.owner` is null, so every one of these yields false and the vendor's name and logo are emitted regardless of the team's or organization's setting. The value is then carried untouched through packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/reminderScheduler.ts:56,97,161,213,248,262,267,280, packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/scheduleMandatoryReminder.ts:18,27,38,82 and packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/reminders/emailReminderManager.ts:38,115,147,182,204 into the rendered body. The scheduled-send side reads it from a second wrong place: packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleEmailReminders.ts:246-248, 274-276 and 433-435 recompute `brandingDisabled` as `reminder.booking.eventType?.team?.hideBranding : reminder.booking.user?.hideBranding` — the team's own column with no parent-organization override, and the booking's user rather than the event type's owner — off data that packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/getWorkflowReminders.ts selects at :164-171 (`user.hideBranding`) and :195-203 (`team: { parentId, hideBranding }`, typed at :40), which never fetches `team.parent.hideBranding` or the owner's organization profile, so the override is not even retrievable there. The third wrong place is packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/EmailWorkflowService.ts:90-93, which does call the resolver but keys it on `workflow.userId`/`workflow.teamId` — the automation's own owner, not the booked event type's owner or team — and threads that result through :103,148,156,233,244,256 to the template at :491. By contrast packages/features/ee/workflows/lib/service/WorkflowService.ts:133-136 uses getHideBranding correctly for routing-form workflows and forwards it at :145 and :169 into packages/features/tasker/tasks/triggerFormSubmittedNoEvent/triggerFormSubmittedNoEventWorkflow.ts:29,41,66, showing the intended pattern the booking-triggered paths omit. Fixing this requires the resolver's data sources to supply the missing columns — packages/features/ee/teams/repositories/TeamRepository.ts:462-469 (findTeamWithParentHideBranding) and packages/features/users/repositories/UserRepository.ts:1323-1332 (findUserWithHideBranding) — and the event-type select at packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/getEventTypesFromDB.ts:109-113, which today fetches only `owner.hideBranding`. The SMS and WhatsApp crons (packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleSMSReminders.ts, packages/features/ee/workflows/api/scheduleWhatsappReminders.ts) contain no hideBranding read at all, which is why the symptom is reported for message bodies rendered through the email templates.
